content.title: Nortech Systems appoints Andrew Walko as SVP, global operations
content.summary: Nortech Systems (NSYS) announced that Andrew Walko has been named Senior Vice President of Global Operations. In his new role, Walko will replace John Lindeen, who is retiring in the first quarter of 2026, and will be responsible for overseeing the Company’s global operations, including Nortech’s facilities in the U.S., Mexico and China, as well as the Company’s global supply chain, new product introductions, production planning and on-time delivery.
